The paper evaluates generated outputs across classification, QA, and language generation tasks using automatic metrics.

quote: We adopt different metrics for each task-category: we measure the performance of classification tasks using micro, macro and weighted F1 scores, and for QA and language generation tasks we use the ROUGE-L metric. We report the ROUGE-L, Exact Match (EM), and ANLS -Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity for all tasks.
